correctness.rationale: The 5x5 strictly upper triangular algebra has ten basis units. A generic linear map has 100 coefficients; expanding each [f(X),X²] entry in commuting cubics gives a 93x100 formal matrix. Independent construction of the 93 formal rows and 83 Boolean-reduced rows matched source dimensions, with ranks 59 over F3 and 55 over F2. Critically, using independently constructed integer coefficient rows and the source certificate column/row guards, a 59x59 determinant was recomputed exactly by SymPy domain elimination as -1. It gives characteristic-independent formal rank at least 59; 41 independent maps (40 maps into Psi plus identity) supply the matching upper bound. The binary reduction has independently checked rank 55 and four explicit additional maps, giving the 45-dimensional F2 solution. Multivariate polynomial interpolation is valid for q>2 because the degree in each variable is <=2<q. In F2 the reduction x²=x characterizes all evaluations. This verifies precise q=2 versus q>2 separation, without extending the complete classification to n>5.
residual_risks: Own rank check uses finite coefficient enumeration but the coefficient matrix is an exact finite encoding of the universal field-linear functional identity; the unit determinant and interpolation complete the proof.
Did not independently verify all the proposed n>5 embeddings by explicit high-n matrices, but endpoint identity follows by direct matrix-unit multiplication.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Bounds covers arbitrary matrix size n>=4 but only characteristic zero; this is not broader in the finite-field direction. Lan/Liu study [f(X),X]=0 on infinite triangular rings, a strictly stronger functional condition for a different algebra, which does not classify the assigned 2-power commuting solutions.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge: Bounds Theorem 1.2 is a characteristic-zero result with the same standard form, and proof explicitly uses char !=2. Its all-char-zero assertion does not imply dimensions over finite fields; F2 exceptional maps are ruled out by that proof only in excluded fields. Relevant other published finite-field twisted-commutator work studies the rank of Y->XY-lambda YX for fixed X, not field-linear maps f with [f(X),X²] identically zero.

value.rationale: This identifies a sharp genuine field-size boundary in the first nontrivial 5x5 niltriangular case: 41 generic directions versus exactly 45 over F2, with explicit nonstandard maps and an integral unit-minor certificate. A complete natural finite-field classification and motivated counterexamples to characteristic-zero extrapolation are independently useful; no general-n classification is needed.

final_claim: For field-linear maps f:N_5(F_q)->N_5(F_q) satisfying [f(X),X^2]=0, dimension is 41 for all q>2 with standard lambda X + Hom(N_5,Psi) form; over F2 it is 45 with exactly four explicit extra maps; those four extra directions extend as examples to all n>=5, not a complete higher-size classification.
limitations: No claim of complete n>5 classification or classification of arbitrary additive non-field-linear maps.
